title: CPSC, Aqua Scout Announce Recall of Aqua Scout Water Scooters
summary: Hydrogen gas can build up in the battery compartment and cause the battery cover and the battery package to forcefully expel from the product, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 475.

title: CPSC, Atico International USA, Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Arm Band Pool Floats Sold at CVS Stores
summary: The seams of the inflatable arm bands can tear, causing them to deflate. This poses a drowning hazard to young children. Units: About 480,000 pairs.

title: CPSC, World Wide Cycle Supply Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Toys "R" Us
summary: The fork that holds the front wheel can separate at the weld, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 25,000.

title: CPSC, American Greetings Corp. Announce Recall of Sesame Street Sunglasses
summary: The lens in the sunglasses can separate from frames, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 120,000.

title: CPSC, Walt Disney World Co. Announce Recall of Children's Red Sunglasses
summary: The paint on the red sunglasses contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 12,900.

title: CPSC, Robertshaw Controls Co. Announce Recall of Gas Control Valves on Water Heaters
summary: Screws on some water heater valves could break. If this happens, gas could leak from the valve, which poses a risk of gas explosion and fire. Units: About 178,000.

title: CPSC, Bradshaw International Inc. Announce Recall of Bottle Sipper Caps
summary: The pull-up valve can detach from the cap, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500,000.

title: CPSC, Ortovox USA Announce Recall of Avalanche Transceivers
summary: The batteries in these devices can become dislodged when the transceiver is struck sharply. The transceiver could fail to function properly in the aftermath of an avalanche, and result in the buried victim not being found in time to avoid serious injury or death. Units: About 15,500.

title: CPSC, Pier 1 Imports Announce Recall of Glass Candle Holders
summary: The candle holder can unexpectedly break, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Capresso Inc. Announce Recall of Water Kettles
summary: The handle can detach from the glass carafe, spilling hot water and causing severe burn injuries. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Sony Computer Entertainment America Inc. Announce Recall of Certain AC Adaptors Sold with Slim Version PlayStation 2 Systems
summary: The recalled AC adaptors can overheat and melt. This poses the risk of fire, burn and shock injuries to consumers. Units: About 843,000.

title: CPSC, The Brinkmann Corporation Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills
summary: The regulators on these gas grills, the components that control the amount of gas released to the burner, could leak gas when attached to certain liquid propane tanks. This poses a risk of fire and burn injuries. Units: About 130,000.

title: CPSC, DOLMAR Power Products Announce Recall of Chain Saws
summary: The flywheels on some of the chain saws may come apart during use, which could cause serious personal injury. Units: About 1,300 units.

title: CPSC, Makita U.S.A. Inc. Announce Recall of Chain Saws
summary: The flywheels on some of the chain saws can come apart during use, which could cause serious personal injury. Units: About 3,400 units.

title: CPSC, Continental Creations, Inc. Announce Recall of Menorahs
summary: The cups holding the candles on these menorahs are not constructed of the correct material and could ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 480.

title: CPSC, E-Z-GO Announce Recall to Repair Golf Cars
summary: High engine temperatures can permit fuel to get into the air filter box, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 60,000.

title: CPSC, Nexgrill Industries Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills Sold Exclusively At Home Depot
summary: The hose connecting the propane tank with the manifold can run up too close to the firebox. The heat from the firebox can damage the hose, causing it to leak gas. The release of gas creates a fire risk that could cause injury and property damage. Units: About 86,000.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Spindle Cribs
summary: The spindles on the crib's front rail can loosen and detach from the rail. This can allow the child to fall from the crib and poses a risk of entrapment. Units: About 7,600.

title: CPSC, The Coleman Company, Inc. Announce the Recall to Repair Coleman® Gas Grills and Patio Heaters
summary: The regulators on these products can leak propane when the propane cylinder is turned on and the product is not in use. This can pose a fire or explosion hazard. Units: About 124,000 grills and about 6,200 heaters.

title: CPSC, Ultimate Chopper LLC Announce Recall to Inspect and Replace Food Processors
summary: The interlocking lid assembly on the appliance can malfunction, allowing the food processor to be operated when the lid is off. This can result in a laceration or fingertip amputation hazard, if consumers insert their hands into the food processor. Units: About 1.5 million.

title: CPSC, Greenheck Fan Corp. Announce Recall of Ventilation Units
summary: LUX 3/8-inch spinlock bolts supplied with these units may not have been properly heat treated, which can result in the bolts breaking. Bolt failure during lifting for rooftop installation or after installation could cause the unit or components to fall and injure bystanders. Units: About 4,200 venti

title: CPSC, Panasonic Corporation of North America Announce Recall of DLP Projector
summary: If the lamp drive circuit touches the shield case, the unit is not grounded and, if a person were to contact metal terminals at the back of the unit, there is a potential for electric shock. Units: 21.

title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall of Washing Machines
summary: If the front-load washer is operated at maximum load capacity, the spinner could malfunction and break apart, posing a safety risk to consumers. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, W.C. Wood Company Inc. Announce Recall of Upright Freezers and Single Door Refrigerators
summary: The defrost heater coil can become exposed inside the units, which poses a potential shock hazard to consumers. In some cases, the exposed heater wire can also melt, or burn the unit's interior plastic food liner. Units: About 112,000.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of Off-Highway Utility Vehicles
summary: The brakes on these vehicles can fail. Units: About 700.

title: CPSC, Dollar General Corp. Announce Recall of Costume Jewelry
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 455,000.

title: CPSC, Monogram International Inc. Announce Recall of Bracelet Keyrings
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 145,000.

title: CPSC, Pacific Market International, LLC (PMI) Announce Recall of Stanley Vacuum Bottles
summary: The handle on the thermos bottles can break, causing the vacuum seal to fail and release organic, non-toxic charcoal powder insulation into the air. This can cause consumers to suffer short-term vision problems and temporary breathing problems when they inhale the powder. Units: About 45,000.

title: CPSC, Douglas Company Announce Recall of Plush Toys
summary: Beads of glitter glue on the colored ribbons could detach and pose an aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 1,100.
